people.name: Pekah
people.line: King of Israel who reigned for 20 years

people.name: Remaliah
people.line: Father of Pekah, king of Israel

people.name: Rezin
people.line: King of Aram (Syria) during the reign of Ahaz

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: In those days, Yahweh began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
translations.bsb: (In those days the LORD began to send Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.)
translations.kjv: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
translations.asv: In those days Jehovah began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
